correctness.rationale: At base e_j, choose lower/upper bits on positive support S_j. The exact tangent cone splits |S_j| orthant rays and, over each other base layer ℓ, 2^{|S_ℓ\S_j|} extreme rays, giving adjacency, degree and edge counts by counting support assignments. Degree minus n+d equals Σ_{ℓ !=j}(2^{r_jℓ}-1)-|Z_j|≥0, equality iff every absent row is singleton outside j with no shared column; requiring all j yields global full/singleton disjoint support criterion. Under simplicity primitive edge determinant is product of singleton entries, so smooth iff each equals 1. Proof is all-dimensional; independent exact rational active-facet rank and determinants check 444 matrices, 3870 vertices.
